en-e1-l1.title: Alfaabeetii fi Sagalee Jalqabaa
en-e1-l1.concept: Jechi tokko yoo sagalee jalqabaa fi qubee jalqabaa beekame salphaatti yaadatama. Sagalee baasuudhaan hordofii dubbisi.

en-e1-l2.title: Nagaa Gaafachuu
en-e1-l2.concept: Yeroo wal arganu **Hello**, yeroo adda baanu **Goodbye** jenna. Maqaa keenya **My name is ...** jennee dubbanna.

en-e1-l3.title: Lakkoofsa fi Halluu
en-e1-l3.concept: one, two, three... lakkoofsota fi red, blue, yellow... jechoota halluu baradhu.

en-e1-l4.title: Maatii
en-e1-l4.concept: mother (haadha), father (abbaa), grandmother (aanoo), baby (daa'ima) akka jedhamu jechoota maatii waamaniidha.

en-e1-l5.title: Jechoota Kutaa Barnootaa
en-e1-l5.concept: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... jechoota kutaa barnootaa keessatti fayyadaman Afaan Ingiliffaan dubbadhu.

en-e2-l1.title: Maqaa Bineensotaa fi Waantotaa
en-e2-l1.concept: rabbit (bakakkaa), bird (simbirroo), fish (qurxummii) akka jedhamu jechoota maqaa agarsiisan **maqaa** jedhamu.

en-e2-l2.title: Jechoota Socho'ii Agarsiisan
en-e2-l2.concept: jump (utaaluu), run (fiiguu), eat (nyaachuu) akka jedhamu jechoota socho'ii agarsiisan **gochima** jedhamu.

en-e2-l3.concept: **I like ...** jechuun 'Ani ... jaalladha', **I have ...** jechuun 'Ani ... qaba' jechuu dha.

en-e2-l4.title: Himoota Gabaabaa Ijaaruu
en-e2-l4.concept: I booda **am**, You booda **are** fayyadamna. Hima tokko tartiiba 'eenyu → akkam/maal' hordofa.

en-e2-l5.title: Barreeffama Gabaabaa Dubbisuu
en-e2-l5.concept: Yeroo barreeffama dubbisu, dura jecha gaaffii barreeffama keessaa barbaadi.

en-e3-abc1.title: Qubee Guddaa fi Xiqqaa Alfaabeetii
en-e3-abc1.concept: Alfaabeetiin **qubee guddaa** fi **qubee xiqqaa** qaba. Bifa adda ta'an baay'ee waan jiraniif tokko tokkoon wal-qabsiisuun yaadadhu. Qubee wal fakkaatan akka b, d, p, q irratti addatti of eegi.

en-e3-l1.title: Hima Ijaaruu
en-e3-l1.concept: Hima tokko tartiiba 'eenyu → maal godha → maal' hordofa. He, She, fi maqaa nama booda gochimni **-s** fudhata.

en-e3-l3.title: Yeroo Ammaa fi Yeroo Darbe
en-e3-l3.concept: Waan amma yookaan irra deddeebi'ee ta'u **yeroo ammaa**, waan darbe immoo dhuma gochimaa irratti **-ed** dabalachuudhaan **yeroo darbe** fayyadamna.

en-e3-l4.title: Sagantaa Guyyaa
en-e3-l4.concept: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... sagantaa guyyaa Afaan Ingiliffaan dubbadhu.

en-e3-l5.title: Barreeffama Hubachuu
en-e3-l5.concept: Barreeffama dubbisiitii eenyutu, yoom, maal akka godhe barbaadi.

en-e3-snd1.title: Walitti dhufeenya sagalee fi qubeessuu
en-e3-snd1.concept: Sagaleen jalqabaa jechaa fi qubeen jalqabaa wal-qunnamtii qabu. Jechoota sagalee wal-fakkaatuun jalqaban barbaaduun walitti dhufeenya sagalee fi qubeessuu baradhu. Qubeewwan lama akka ph f jedhee sagaluu danda'u.

en-e4-l1.title: Yeroo ammaa, darbe fi egeree
en-e4-l1.concept: Waan ammaa fi irra-deddeebi'u **bifa yeroo ammaa**, waan darbe **-ed**, waan egeree **will + jecha gochaa bu'uuraa** tiin dubbata.

en-e4-l2.title: Gaaffii fi ukkaamsuu
en-e4-l2.concept: Dubbiin gaaffii **Do/Does** tiin jalqaba; yeroo 'miti' jedhan **don't/doesn't** fayyadamu.

en-e4-l3.title: Jechoota bifa fi miira agarsiisan
en-e4-l3.concept: big (guddaa), small (xiqqaa), hot (ho'aa), cold (qabbanaa'aa) akka jedhuutti bifa yookaan miira kan ibsan jechoota dha.

en-e4-l5.title: Barruu gabaabaa dubbisuu
en-e4-l5.concept: Eenyu, eessatti, maal akka hojjete barruu keessaa barbaadii deebisi.

en-e5-l1.title: Artikilii, baay'ina fi There is/are
en-e5-l1.concept: Sagalee dubbachiiftuu duraan **an**, sagalee dubbifamaa duraan **a** fayyadami. Yoo tokko ta'e **There is**, yoo baay'ee ta'e **There are** fayyadami.

en-e5-l2.title: Jechoota wal-bira qabuu
en-e5-l2.concept: Yeroo lama wal-bira qabdu **-er + than**, kan hundaa caalaa ...-u **the -est** fayyadami. Jechoota dheeraaf **more** fayyadami.

en-e5-l3.title: Haala egeree
en-e5-l3.concept: Waan egeree **will + jecha gochaa bu'uuraa** yookaan **be going to + jecha gochaa bu'uuraa** tiin dubbata.

en-e5-l4.title: Hima jijjiiruu
en-e5-l4.concept: Ukkaamsa **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**, gaaffii immoo **Are / Do / Does** hima duraa irratti barreessi.

en-e5-l5.title: Barruu hubachuu
en-e5-l5.concept: Barruu dheeraa yoo eenyu, eessa, yoom, maal jedhu sararaa jala kaa'uu fakkaatuun barbaadanii dubbiste salphaa dha.

en-e6-l1.title: Cuunfaa yeroo gochaa
en-e6-l1.concept: Waan amma hojjetamu **be + -ing**, waan darbe **bifa yeroo darbee**, waan egeree **will / be going to** tiin dubbata.

en-e6-l2.concept: **can** (danda'a), **must** (qaba), **should** (gaarii dha), **may** (ni danda'a/eeyyamameera) booda jecha gochaa bu'uuraa dhufa.

en-e6-l3.title: Jechoota babal'isuu
en-e6-l3.concept: Jechoota hiika wal-fakkaatu fi faallaa isaanii walitti yoo baratte jechoonni kee dachaa ta'u.

en-e6-l5.title: Keewwata dubbisuu
en-e6-l5.concept: Barruu hima baay'ee qabu dubbisiitii eenyu, yoom, maaliif akka hojjete barbaadii deebisi.

en-e6-pun1.title: Qubee guddaa fi mallattoo qubee-bu'aa
en-e6-pun1.concept: Hima **qubee guddaan** jalqabi, dhuma irratti **mallattoo qubee-bu'aa** sirrii barreessi. Kallattiidhaan hima idilee kan ta'e tuqaa (.), gaaffii mallattoo gaaffii (?), dinqisiifannaa yookaan miira cimaa mallattoo dinqisiifannaa (!) fayyadami. Maqaa nama fi I yeroo hundaa qubee guddaadhaan barreeffama.

en-e6-seq1.title: Tartiiba wantootaa hubachuu
en-e6-seq1.concept: **First** (jalqaba), **Then / Next** (itti aansee), **After that** (isa booda), **Finally** (dhumarratti) akka jedhutti jechoota tartiiba agarsiisan yoo barbaadde tartiiba wantaa beekta.

en-h1-l1.title: Yeroo xumurame fi xumurame-itti-fufaa
en-h1-l1.concept: had + p.p. waan yeroo darbe dura ta'e, have been -ing gochaa hanga ammaatti itti fufe dha.

en-h1-l2.title: Hima-ibsa fi kutaa maqaa
en-h1-l2.concept: where / when / why hima-ibsa gahee ibsa gochimaa qabu dha; whether / that kutaa maqaa geggeessu.

en-h1-l3.title: Kutaa participial
en-h1-l3.concept: Jecha walitti-hidhaa fi mata-duree hir'isii gochima -ing tti jijjiiri. Mata-dureen hiikaa wal-fakkaachuu qaba.

en-h1-l4.title: Jechoota walitti-hidhan fi adeemsa barreeffamaa
en-h1-l4.concept: Sababa–bu'aa (so, therefore), faallaa (however), fakkeenya (for example), dabaluu (in addition) adda baasi.

en-h1-l5.title: Yaada ijoo hubachuu fi iddoo duwwaa tilmaamuu
en-h1-l5.concept: Yaadni ijoo However booda (yaada waliigalaa jijjiirame) fi hima dhumaa irra jira. Iddoo duwwaa rakkoo → furmaata → bu'aa akka adeemsa tti tilmaami.

en-h2-l1.title: Ibsa jijjiirame fi caasaa cimsuu
en-h2-l1.concept: Never/Hardly/Only then yoo jalqaba hima irra ta'e tartiibni gargaaraa + mata-duree ta'a. It is ~ that tiin cimsi.

en-h2-l2.title: Gaaffii yaadaa (subjunctive)
en-h2-l2.concept: I wish / as if / If keessatti faallaa yeroo ammaa bifa darbe, faallaa yeroo darbee had p.p. fayyadami.

en-h2-l3.title: Hima-ibsa walitti-qabame fi kutaa ittifufiinsa (concessive)
en-h2-l3.concept: whatever, whoever, whichever, however + ibsa maqaa ‘…yoo ta'e illee, hammam…’ jechuudha.

en-h2-l4.title: Jechoota haala keessatti
en-h2-l4.concept: Mallattoo faallaa·fakkeenya·sababa fi duraa jechaatiin hiika jecha hin beekne tilmaami.

en-h2-l5.title: Guddina yaadaa barreeffamaa
en-h2-l5.concept: Kallattii jecha nutii (this, they) fi jechoota walitti-hidhan irraa adeemsa barreeffamaa hordofii, odeeffannoo bal'inaa walitti qabii xumura argadhu.

en-h3-l1.title: Caasaa walitti-hidhamaa (parallel) fi walsimuu mata-duree-gochima
en-h3-l1.concept: Jechoonni and/but/or tiin walitti hidhaman bifa wal-fakkaatuun, gochimni mata-duree ijoo wajjin wal-simsiisi.

en-h3-l2.title: Haala, sagalee fi kaayyoo
en-h3-l2.concept: Jechoota ibsaa fi miiraan haala, deebii gaafachuu·qajeelfama·amansiisuu irraa kaayyoo barreeffamaa hubadhu.

en-h3-l3.title: Tartiiba hima fi gidduu galchuu
en-h3-l3.concept: Jechoota walitti-hidhan, nutii (reference) fi tartiiba yeroo akka mallattootti fayyadamii hima tartiibsi; iddoo hima kennameef itti galu barbaadi.

en-h3-l4.title: Walitti-hidhamiinsa jechaa fi jechoota aadaa
en-h3-l4.concept: make a decision, take a risk, heavy rain akka wal-fakkaatan wal-qabatanii beeki; jechoota aadaa haala irraa hiika tilmaami.
en-h3-l4.example: the last straw = daangaa obsa dhumaa

en-h3-l5.title: Cuunfa guutuu
en-h3-l5.concept: Yaada ijoo barreeffamaa fi ibsa faallaa barbaadii hima tokkootti gabaabsi.

en-h3e-l1.title: Jecha haala wajjin wal-simu filachuu
en-h3e-l1.concept: Gaaffiin haasaa seerlugni sirrii ta'uu isaa wajjin, haala sana keessatti haasaan uumamaa fi ulfina qabaachuu isaa ilaaluu barbaada. Dhiyeessa, dubbii gidduutti seenuu, galateeffannaaf deebii, jecha aadaa, fi karaa xiqqaadhaan dubbachuu baay'inaan dhufa.

en-h3e-l2.title: Ibsa hojii fi jechoota walitti-hidhaman
en-h3e-l2.concept: Afaan Ingiliffaa hojii keessatti jechi aadaa (touch base), gabaabsa (ASAP fi kkf), fi wal-qabsiisa gochima fi qooda-jecha (collocation) ijoo dha. Jecha-jechaan hin hiikin; akka kutaa haala hojii keessatti fayyadamu yaadadhu.

en-h3e-l3.title: Odeeffannoo qeequun dubbisuu
en-h3e-l3.concept: Afaan Ingiliffaa midiyaa keessatti dhugaa fi yaada adda baasuu, fi sababni falmii keessatti fayyadame sirrii moo hin taane qorachuuf humni barbaachisaa dha. Jechoota akka ibsa fakkii (alt text, caption) fi meeshaalee gulaaluu illee kaayyoon yaadadhu.

en-h3e-l4.title: Jechoota aadaa fi qabiyyee banaa
en-h3e-l4.concept: Mataduree aadaa addunyaa keessatti jechoota ijoo akka culture, diversity, stereotype fi aadaa biraa osoo hin murteessin hubachuuf ibsa ibsaman baradhu. Jechoonni hiika wal-fakkaatu qaban mallattoo haala keessaa irraa addaan baafamu.

en-h3e-l5.title: Hojii ogummaa jechoota ogbarruutiin dubbisuu
en-h3e-l5.concept: Gaaffiin ogbarruu hiika jecha beekuu fi taateewwan seenaa keessaa irratti fayyadamuu ijoo dha. Dubbii dura agarsiisu (foreshadowing), mallattoo (symbol), ilaalcha (point of view), mata-duree (theme), fi gahee amala (character) gargar baasi.

en-h3e-l6.title: Sababa fi dogoggora logic addaan baasuu
en-h3e-l6.concept: Falmii keessatti jechoota (motion, rebuttal kkf), gosa ragaa, fi dogoggora logic gargar baasuuf humna barbaachisa. Falmii yeroo madaaltu 'Dubbiin kun ragaa maali qaba?' jedhii dura gaafadhu.

en-h3e-l7.title: Barreeffama sirrii fi kaayyoo wajjin wal-simatu
en-h3e-l7.concept: Barreeffama keessatti kaayyoo barreeffamaa fi dubbistoota wajjin wal-simatu bifa filadhu; kutaa hima (dhimma fi gochaa) fi logic jechoota walitti hidhan mirkaneessi. Barreeffamni addaa akka CV hojii fi lakkoofsa dubbii dhokataa caalaa gaarii dha.

en-l1.title: Jechoota guyyaa guyyaa baruu
en-l1.concept: Jechoota yeroo baay'ee fayyadamnu **sagalee + hiika + barreessuu** waliin yoo baratan yeroo dheeraaf yaadatamu. Button sagaleetiin dubbisa dhaga'i.
en-l1.example: library = mana kitaabaa / desk = minjaala / milk = aannan

en-l2.title: Gochaa be: am / are / is
en-l2.concept: Gochaan be dhimma irratti hundaa'ee bifa isaa jijjiira. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.

en-l3.title: Gochaa idilee yeroo ammaa
en-l3.concept: Dhimmi **he / she / it (nama sadaffaa tokko)** yoo ta'e gochaa irratti **-s / -es** dabali. -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o jedhee xumuramu yoo ta'e -es, qubee dhaabbataa+y yoo ta'e y gara i jijjiiri -es!

en-l4.title: Bifa baay'ee fi hima tolchuu
en-l4.concept: Maqaan lamaa ol yoo ta'e yeroo baay'ee **-s** dabali, -x jedhee xumuramu yoo ta'e **-es**, bifa baay'ee seera-hin-qabne adda qabadhu. Himni tartiiba **dhimma → gochaa → kutaa hafe** dha.

en-m2-l1.title: Yeroo ammaa raawwate (Present perfect)
en-m2-l1.concept: have/has + participle darbe. Muuxannoo, xumura, itti fufiinsa agarsiisa; since (yeroo) fi for (turtii) gargar baasi.

en-m2-l2.title: Bifa jechuu (Passive)
en-m2-l2.concept: be + participle darbe tiin 'ta'uu/rakkachuu' agarsiisa. Raawwataan by tiin dabalama.

en-m2-l3.title: To infinitive fi gerund
en-m2-l3.concept: want, hope, decide + to infinitive, enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V kaayyoo, stop + V-ing dhaabuu dha.

en-m2-l4.title: Wal-bira qabuu (Comparative) fi isa olaanaa (Superlative)
en-m2-l4.concept: -er/-est fi more/most. Wal-bira qabuu irratti than, isa olaanaa irratti the fayyadami. good → better → best seera-hin-qabne dha.

en-m2-l5.title: Dubbisuu: mata-duree fi odeeffannoo bal'aa
en-m2-l5.concept: Gaaffii dura dubbisii hima mallattoo barbaadi. Mata-duree fi ijoon barreeffama guutuu kan of keessaa qabu dha.

en-m2-sum1.title: Qabiyyee barreeffamaa cuunfuu
en-m2-sum1.concept: Barreeffama yeroo cuunfitu **qabiyyee ijoo** barbaadii hima tokko lama keessatti gabaabsi. Odeeffannoo bal'aa tokko qofa dubbachuu, wanta barreeffama keessa hin jirre dabaluu, yookaan baay'ee bal'ifamee dubbachuun cuunfaa gaarii miti.

en-m3-l1.title: Relative pronoun
en-m3-l1.concept: who (nama), which (wanta), that (lamaanuu), whose (abbaa-qabeenyaa) tiin hima lama tokkotti walitti hidhi.

en-m3-l2.title: Hima haala-qabeessa fi subjunctive yeroo darbe
en-m3-l2.concept: If + yeroo ammaa, will + V (wanta danda'amu). If + yeroo darbe, would + V (yaada yeroo ammaa faallaa).

en-m3-l3.title: Gaaffii al-kallattii
en-m3-l3.concept: Jecha gaaffii + dhimma + gochaa tartiibaan barreessi. do/does/did hin fayyadamin.

en-m3-l4.title: Participle
en-m3-l4.concept: -ing kallattii hojjetaa·itti fufaa, -ed kallattii dhimma-hojii·xumurame dha. Miira yoo uumu -ing, yoo dhaga'e -ed dha.

en-m3-l5.title: Dubbisuu: Tilmaamuu fi kaayyoo barreeffamaa
en-m3-l5.concept: Mallattoowwan walitti qabii tilmaami, kaayyoon barreeffamaa gaaffii·falmii ilaaluun murtaa'a.

e-be-1.prompt: I ____ a student. (am / are / is keessaa isa sirrii)
e-be-1.explanation: I yeroo hundaa am wajjin fayyada: I am a student.
hints: Yeroo mata-dureen I ta'u gochima ‘be’ tokko jira.
I booda hiriyaa isaa am dhufa.

e-be-2.explanation: Nama sadaffaa tokkoo (She) is wajjin fayyada: She is my friend.
hints: Mata-dureen She nama sadaffaa tokkoo dha.
he / she / it wajjin gochimni be isa kami?

e-be-3.explanation: They baay'ina qaba kanaaf are: They are in the classroom.
hints: They mata-duree baay'ina qabu dha.
Mata-duree baay'ina qabu (we, you, they) wajjin are fayyadamna.

e-be-4.explanation: My brother = he waan ta'eef is: My brother is tall.
hints: My brother nama tokko dha. Nama meeqaffaa?
Nama sadaffaa tokkoo → is

e-be-5.prompt: Kanneen armaan gadii keessaa hima sirrii isa kami?
e-be-5.explanation: We are ready. qofa mata-duree fi gochima be wajjin wal simu.
hints: Wal-qabsiisa mata-dureefi be tokko tokkoon mirkaneessi.

Walitti dhufeenya gochaa durbaa fi bu'aa isaa gara hima tokkootti waliigaluu isaa fi seenaa faallessuu dhiisuu isaa mirkaneessi.

e-h3e-lit-5.explanation: Deebiin protagonist (gooftaa seenaa) dha. Giddugala seenaa irratti kaayyoo qabatee taateewwan geggeessa. Antagonist nama gooftaa seenaa morme waan ta'eef gaheen isaa faallaa dha.
